title: Geoff Britton auditions for Wings | 1974
content:
Geoff Britton had a day of auditioning with Wings on 13 May 1974.

Britton was one of 52 drummers to take part in two days of auditions on 29 and 30 April. He then became one of five shortlisted players who were again auditioned on 8 and 9 May.

The final two were Britton and Rob Townsend. On this day Britton played a number of songs with Wings at London’s Electric Ballroom. They also took lunch together at a restaurant to see how the drummer interacted with the rest of the band away from the stage.

On 16 May, Paul McCartney called Britton to tell him he had the job, completing the line-up of Wings mark II.
